title: German Basisschrift B3 Contract Role Taxonomy

INDICATOR.definition: The primary normative effect is deterministic insertion or declaration of a Braille marker, prefix, announcement, or delimiter.

STATE_SCOPE.definition: The primary normative effect is lifecycle, span scope, termination, continuation, or state-boundary semantics.

STRUCTURAL.definition: The primary normative effect is layout, ordering, spacing, serialization structure, index arrangement, line-boundary behavior, or table structure.

POLICY_SELECTION.definition: The primary normative effect is selection between permitted methods, profiles, forms, optimizations, or representation strategies.

BEHAVIORAL_CONSTRAINT.definition: The rule imposes a normative or admitted behavioral condition, prohibition, exception, requirement, or transformation constraint not dominated by another contract role.

DELEGATED_REFERENCE.definition: The primary semantic responsibility is delegated to another normative subsystem or runtime owner; a dependency field alone is insufficient.

REFERENCE_ONLY.definition: The rule must remain available for normative interpretation or fallback reasoning but is not an executable contract of the six-dot Basisschrift runtime.

CROSS_MODE_DEFERRED.definition: The rule is valid canonical evidence but its explicit applicability excludes the current Basisschrift runtime and belongs to a later German text mode.

ARCHITECTURAL_ONLY.definition: The rule records architectural inference, ownership, or abstraction rather than normative executable behavior.

adjudicationSemantics.architecturalOnlyGate: Requires architectural semantics/status or equivalent explicit architectural evidence; normative=false alone is insufficient.
adjudicationSemantics.crossModeDeferredGate: Requires explicit applicability that excludes the current Basisschrift mode.
adjudicationSemantics.referenceOnlyGate: Requires source semantics necessary for interpretation but outside the executable six-dot Basisschrift contract.
adjudicationSemantics.delegatedReferenceGate: Requires delegation to be the primary semantic responsibility; a dependency field alone is insufficient.
adjudicationSemantics.structuralGate: Primary effect is serialization, layout, ordering, spacing, table/index structure, or line-boundary behavior.
adjudicationSemantics.stateScopeGate: Primary effect is state/span lifecycle, scope, termination, or continuation.
adjudicationSemantics.policySelectionGate: Primary effect is choosing among source-authorized forms, methods, profiles, or optimizations.
adjudicationSemantics.indicatorGate: Primary effect is deterministic marker/prefix/announcement insertion or declaration.
adjudicationSemantics.behavioralConstraintGate: Residual admitted behavior that imposes a condition, prohibition, exception, requirement, or transformation constraint.
